title: קצי׳ בשר
notes: Heading 'קצי בשר' (apparently short for קציצות בשר) followed by a slash and a name, read as 'שולה' (source); written in thin pen on a card with a metal clip at the top corner (the clip hides nothing essential but crosses the title).
Written very lightly and the writing is shaky; the last two lines and a few words remain unclear.
'א. מרק' is written as an abbreviation (probably 'אבקת מרק'); left as written, not expanded.
A short line '1 בצל' (after the herbs line) was missed in the earlier reading and is added after a second opinion; the letters are shaky but consistent with the ink.
Source set by the owner (issue #379): שולה.
